source.citation: S. D. Ganjave, V. A. J. E. S. Waghmare, P. P. Wangikar, 'High cell density cultivation of E. coli in shake flasks for the production of recombinant proteins', Biotechnology Reports 33 (2022) e00694.
source.fitting_statement: The paper states the parameters were estimated by fitting the model to six fed-batch experiments (p. 5) with a hybrid scheme: a genetic algorithm to locate the region of the optimum followed by MATLAB's fmincon to refine it. The model was then validated on two further experimental combinations. Every parameter below is therefore FITTED, not measured, even though the values are printed.
